title: Deliver Wood to Frondworth Falls Sawmill
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Wood** delivered to **Frondworth Falls Sawmill** (industry id 26, near tile 199,54).

A likely supplier is **Frondworth Falls Forest** (industry id 3, near tile 221,55); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **430 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
